Rebirth resets your Tungs to 0 and ALL upgrade levels to 0 — then hands you your Starting Tungs bonus. It also removes your unlocked skins: you go back to Classic Tung Tung and re-earn skins from crates (the Rebirth skin returns at 5+ Rebirths). You keep your Gambling Stats, badges and identity. Every Rebirth permanently grants +1x Click Power (1 Rebirth = 2x clicks, 2 = 3x, 3 = 4x…), +25% TTPS, +5,000 Starting Tungs, and -1% upgrade costs (max -25%).

🔒 1 Rebirth — Title “Reborn” + an extra +25% multiplier
🔒 3 Rebirths — Title “Triple Reborn” + 25,000 bonus Starting Tungs
🔒 5 Rebirths — Exclusive Rebirth Tung Tung skin + Title “Ascended”
🔒 10 Rebirths — Title “Multiverse Overlord” + an extra x1.5 multiplier + 250,000 bonus Starting Tungs

📦 Skin Crates

📦
Basic Sahur Crate
Spin the roulette for a skin! Whatever it lands on is yours — then equip it from your Skins inventory. Roll a skin you already own and you get +50 Tungs back instead.
🌟
Basic+ Sahur Crate
An upgraded Sahur crate with tiered odds — Common 74% • Uncommon 20% • Rare 4% • Epic 1% • Mythic 1% — and the only place to roll Silver Tung Tung. Roll a skin you already own and you get +100 Tungs back instead.
🛸
Event Crate
The UFO has landed! A premium crate with boosted odds — and the only place to roll Alien Tung Tung, the 1.5% RARE drop. Roll a skin you already own and you get +500 Tungs back instead.
🌙
Advanced Sahur Crate
The moonlit endgame crate — NO Common drops, ever. Every roll is Uncommon or better, and it is the only place to roll the two SECRET drops: Tung Tung Moon and Clockwork Tung Tung, 0.15% each. Roll a skin you already own and you get +250 Tungs back instead.
